rule: 14-digit SIRET establishment -> its 9-digit SIREN prefix, both current and in Nouvelle-Aquitaine
source: INSEE SIRENE stock (public data, no paid service)

sql.candidates:
SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM org c JOIN org p
		ON p.entity_source = 'sirene' AND p.entity_code = left(c.entity_code, 9)
		AND p.valid_to IS NULL AND p.dept IN ('16','17','19','23','24','33','40','47','64','79','86','87')
		WHERE c.entity_source = 'sirene-site' AND c.valid_to IS NULL AND c.dept IN ('16','17','19','23','24','33','40','47','64','79','86','87') AND c.entity_code ~ '^[0-9]{14}$'
sql.established:
SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM org c JOIN org p ON p.id = c.parent_org_id
		WHERE c.parent_evidence->>'method' = 'siren-prefix'
		AND c.valid_to IS NULL AND p.valid_to IS NULL
		AND c.dept IN ('16','17','19','23','24','33','40','47','64','79','86','87') AND p.dept IN ('16','17','19','23','24','33','40','47','64','79','86','87')
sql.byDepartment:
SELECT c.dept, count(*)::text AS n FROM org c JOIN org p ON p.id = c.parent_org_id
		WHERE c.parent_evidence->>'method' = 'siren-prefix'
		AND c.valid_to IS NULL AND p.valid_to IS NULL
		AND c.dept IN ('16','17','19','23','24','33','40','47','64','79','86','87') AND p.dept IN ('16','17','19','23','24','33','40','47','64','79','86','87')
		GROUP BY c.dept ORDER BY c.dept
